Social Security Administration
Notice of Overpayment
Date: September 22, 2026
JANE Q. SAMPLE
Claim Number: XXX-XX-1234
We are writing to tell you that we paid you $6,240.00 too much in Social Security disability benefits for the period March 2025 through October 2025.
Why you were overpaid: Our records show that you worked and earned $1,850 per month starting March 2025. These earnings exceeded the substantial gainful activity amount after your trial work period ended. We did not reduce your benefits for these months.
What you need to do: Please refund the full amount within 30 days. If we do not receive the refund or hear from you within 30 days, we will withhold your full monthly benefit of $1,412.00 beginning with your December 2026 payment.
If you disagree: You have 60 days from the date you receive this letter to ask for reconsideration. We assume you received this letter 5 days after the date on it. If you ask within 30 days, we will not withhold your benefits until we decide.
Waiver: You may ask us to waive collection if the overpayment was not your fault and you cannot afford to pay it back or it would be unfair. You can ask for a waiver at any time.
Social Security Administration, 1-800-772-1213
